class NativeData(pickle.Unpickler):
    def find_class(self,module,name):

        if module in ('numpy.core.multiarray','numpy._core.multiarray') and name in ('_reconstruct','scalar'):return getattr(np._core.multiarray,name)
        if module in ('numpy.core.numeric','numpy._core.numeric') and name=='_frombuffer':return np._core.numeric._frombuffer
        if module=='builtins' and name in ('set','frozenset','slice','complex'):
            import builtins

        raise pickle.UnpicklingError('Non-data native pickle global refused: '+module+'.'+name)

def literal_saved_arithmetic(pose,xml):
    tree=ET.parse(xml).getroot();bodies={node.get('name'):node for node in tree.findall('.//body')}

    origins=[];rotations=[];anchors=[];local=[];extra_targets=[]

        body=bodies[f'mano_body_{i}'];ball=body.find(f"joint[@name='{name}']");require(ball is not None and ball.get('type')=='ball','Literal named ball missing')
        rest=qmat([float(x) for x in body.get('quat','1 0 0 0').split()]);pos=np.asarray([float(x) for x in body.get('pos','0 0 0').split()]);c=np.asarray([float(x) for x in ball.get('pos','0 0 0').split()])
        Q=qmat(named[name]);local.append(mm(rest,Q));extra_targets.append(rest)
        if i==0:
            delta=[]

                joint=body.find(f"joint[@name='{s}']");require(joint is not None and joint.get('type')=='slide','Literal slide missing')
                require(np.array_equal(np.asarray([float(x) for x in joint.get('axis').split()]),np.eye(3)[SLIDES.index(s)]),'Named translation axis changed')
                delta.append(float(named[s])-float(joint.get('ref','0')))
            translated=pos+mv(rest,delta);anchor=translated+mv(rest,c);R=mm(rest,Q)
        else:
            parent=PARENTS[i];pre=mm(rotations[parent],rest);translated=origins[parent]+mv(rotations[parent],pos)
            anchor=translated+mv(pre,c);R=mm(pre,Q)
        origins.append(anchor-mv(R,c));rotations.append(R);anchors.append(anchor)
    wrist=np.eye(4);wrist[:3,:3]=rotations[0];wrist[:3,3]=anchors[0]
    root=wrist.copy();root[:3,3]=origins[0]
    return dict(origins=np.asarray(origins),rotations=np.asarray(rotations),anchors=np.asarray(anchors),local=np.asarray(local),wrist=wrist,root=root,rest=np.asarray(extra_targets))

    mapping={'compiled_joint_anchors_world_m':literal['anchors'],'compiled_world_body_rotations':literal['rotations'],
        'compiled_body_origins_world_m':literal['origins'],'compiled_local_body_rotations':literal['local'],
        'adapter_independent_joint_anchors_world_m':literal['anchors'],'adapter_independent_world_body_rotations':literal['rotations'],
        'adapter_independent_body_origins_world_m':literal['origins'],'wrist_anchor_world_transform':literal['wrist'],'root_body_world_transform':literal['root']}
    require(set(z)==set(mapping),'Kinematic NPZ array inventory changed')
    errors={name:close(z[name],expected,1e-12,'Literal pose/XML saved arithmetic '+name) for name,expected in mapping.items()}
    target=decoded['staging_wrist_world_transform'];close(literal['wrist'],target,1e-12,'Literal staged wrist target')
    for i,name in enumerate(BONES):
        desired=target[:3,:3] if i==0 else decoded['staging_full_rotations'][i]
        close(qmat(pose['named_qpos'][name]),mm(literal['rest'][i].T,desired),1e-12,'Literal quaternion represents staged rotation')
        first=receipt['initial_matrix_to_quaternion_precision'][name];replay=receipt['literal_replay_quaternion_precision'][name]
        require(first['dtype']=='float64' and first['decimal_rounding_applied'] is False,'Initial quaternion precision scope changed')
        require(all(math.isfinite(first[key]) for key in ('raw_norm','normalization_max_change','applied_norm','rotation_max_error')),'Nonfinite initial quaternion precision')
        require(abs(first['raw_norm']-1)<=1e-12 and abs(first['applied_norm']-1)<=1e-12 and first['rotation_max_error']<=1e-12,'Initial matrix/quaternion discrepancy')
        require(replay['literal_roundtrip'] is True and replay['normalization_applied'] is False and replay['decimal_rounding_applied'] is False,'Replay normalized/rounded literal quaternion')
        scalar_equal(replay['input_norm'],norm(pose['named_qpos'][name]),'Replay quaternion norm',1e-14)
    per_bone=[norm(v) for v in z['compiled_joint_anchors_world_m']-decoded['independent_anchors_world_m']]
    anchor=max(per_bone);rotation=maxerr(z['compiled_world_body_rotations'],decoded['independent_rotations_world']);passed=anchor<=5e-6 and rotation<=1e-6
    actual=receipt['kinematic_comparison'];scalar_equal(actual['max_joint_anchor_error_m'],anchor,'Pose anchor max');scalar_equal(actual['max_world_rotation_element_error'],rotation,'Pose rotation max')
    close(actual['per_bone_joint_anchor_errors_m'],per_bone,1e-13,'Per-bone anchor errors')
    require(actual['numerical_pose_pass']==passed and field_report['kinematic_comparison']==actual,'Numerical pose PASS/FAIL interpretation differs')
    require(field_report['literal_pose_readback_pass'] is True and field_report['adapter_static_forwards']==2,'Literal replay operation record changed')
    require(receipt['initial_matrix_to_quaternion_precision']==field_report['initial_matrix_to_quaternion_precision'] and receipt['literal_replay_quaternion_precision']==field_report['literal_replay_quaternion_precision'],'Precision receipt cross-record mismatch')
    return dict(variant=variant,numerical_pose_pass=bool(passed),max_anchor_error_m=anchor,per_bone_anchor_errors_m=per_bone,
        max_rotation_element_error=rotation,literal_saved_array_errors=errors,literal_replay_semantic_readback=True,
        initial_vs_replay_limit='Initial compiled arrays are not separately saved; in-run exact_replay is source/report-bound, not independently bitwise rechecked.',
        model_hash_limit='Model hash is cross-record consistent; compiled model arrays are not independently reconstructed.')


def classify(d,r):
    require(d.ndim==2 and d.shape[1]==6 and r.shape==(len(d),),'Full-field dimensions')
    require(np.isfinite(d).all() and np.isfinite(r).all() and np.all(d>=0) and np.all(r>=0),'Finite nonnegative full-field data')
    error=r[:,None,None]+1e-8;bands=np.asarray([1,2,5])[None,None,:]/1000.
    near=d[:,:,None]+error<=bands;far=np.maximum(0.,d[:,:,None]-error)>bands
    return dict(near=near,far=far,ambiguous=~(near|far))
def surface_readback(folder,variant,grid,report):
    z=arrays(folder/f'{variant}_full_field.npz');q=arrays(grid['original_cache'],('query_object_m','cell_radius_m'));native=arrays(grid['native_cache'],('query_object_m','native_distance_by_part_m'))
    require(np.array_equal(z['query_object_m'],q['query_object_m']) and np.array_equal(z['query_object_m'],native['query_object_m']),'Original fixed-grid query order changed')
    require(np.array_equal(z['cell_radius_m'],q['cell_radius_m']),'Original cell radii changed')
    require(np.array_equal(z['native_distance_by_part_m'],native['native_distance_by_part_m'][:,:6]),'Original native cached distances changed')
    n=classify(z['native_distance_by_part_m'],z['cell_radius_m']);m=classify(z['mapped_distance_by_part_m'],z['cell_radius_m'])
    required=n['near']|n['far'];preserved=(n['near']&m['near'])|(n['far']&m['far']);lost=n['near']&m['far'];added=n['far']&m['near']
    expected=dict(native_near=n['near'],native_far=n['far'],native_ambiguous=n['ambiguous'],required=required,
        preserved=preserved,definite_lost=lost,definite_added=added,unresolved_required=required&~preserved&~(lost|added))
    require(set(z)==set(expected)|{'query_object_m','cell_radius_m','native_distance_by_part_m','mapped_distance_by_part_m'},'Full-field NPZ inventory')
    for name,value in expected.items():require(z[name].dtype==bool and np.array_equal(z[name],value),'Frozen whole-cell predicate differs '+name)
    counts={name:int(value.sum()) for name,value in expected.items()};summary=report['summary']
    for name,value in counts.items():require(summary[name]==value,'Full-field summary count differs '+name)
    status='FAIL' if np.any(lost|added) else 'INCOMPLETE'
    require(counts['required']==grid['required_relationships'] and len(z['query_object_m'])==grid['query_count'],'Full original native-definite denominator differs')
    require(summary['full_strict_mapping_status']==status and report['surface_fidelity_status']==status,'Surface failure/incomplete interpretation differs')
    require(summary['native_definite_relationships_pass']==bool(np.all(~required|preserved)) and summary['no_mapping_pass_issued'] is True,'Surface PASS scope changed')
    require(summary['full_orientation_status']=='NOT_RUN' and summary['continuous_coverage_status']=='NOT_PROVED','Unmeasured orientation/continuous equivalence claimed')
    require(report['native_fidelity_accepted'] is False and report['full_orientation_status']=='NOT_RUN','Surface fidelity admission or orientation measured unexpectedly')
    return dict(variant=variant,status=status,query_cells=len(z['query_object_m']),counts=counts,
        unit='Original fixed-grid cell by same anatomical part by 1/2/5 mm band tuples; overlapping bands are not independent contacts.',
        bands_m=[.001,.002,.005],whole_cell_allowance_m=1e-8,all_predicates_exact=True,
        native_near_preserved=int((n['near']&m['near']).sum()),native_far_preserved=int((n['far']&m['far']).sum()),
        full_orientation_status='NOT_RUN',continuous_surface_equivalence='NOT_PROVED')


def artifact_check(folder,report,complete):
    indexed={}
    for row in report['artifacts']:
        require(set(row)=={'path','sha256','bytes','label'},'Case artifact row schema')
        literal=Path(row['path']);path=literal.resolve()
        require(path.is_relative_to(folder) and literal.is_file() and not literal.is_symlink() and path not in indexed,'Artifact path escaped/duplicated')
        require(sha(path)==row['sha256'] and path.stat().st_size==row['bytes'],'Write-time case artifact changed: '+str(path));indexed[path]=row
    actual_npz={path.resolve() for path in folder.rglob('*.npz')}
    if complete:require(actual_npz=={path for path in indexed if path.suffix=='.npz'},'Unindexed completed-case measurement NPZ')
    return dict(write_time_verified=len(indexed),unindexed_partial_arrays=[str(p) for p in sorted(actual_npz-set(indexed))],
        missing_write_time_rows_are_not_reconstructed_or_assumed=True)

def case_readback(a,p,index,row):
    folder=a.run_dir/str(index)
    if row['status']=='NOT_RUN':
        require(not folder.exists(),'NOT_RUN case has an output directory')
        return dict(index=index,status='NOT_RUN',kinematic_gate='NOT_RUN',surface_gate='NOT_RUN',physical_outcome=None)
    require(sha(row['log'])==row['log_sha256'],'Case log changed')
    if not row.get('result'):
        require(row['status']!='COMPLETED','Completed case has no result')
        return dict(index=index,status='NO_COMPLETED_RESULT',kinematic_gate='UNKNOWN',surface_gate='UNKNOWN',physical_outcome=None)
    require(Path(row['result']).resolve()==folder/'result.json' and sha(row['result'])==row['result_sha256'],'Case result identity/hash differs')
    r=read(row['result']);require(r['schema_version']==TRANSACTION and r['source_inventory_index']==index,'Case schema/index differs')
    require(r['protocol_sha256']==a.protocol_sha256 and r['freeze_commit']==a.freeze_commit,'Case freeze/protocol differs')
    complete=row['status']=='COMPLETED';require((r['status']=='COMPLETED_NATIVE_STATIC_DIAGNOSTIC')==complete,'Completion status disagreement')
    for key in ('native_fidelity_accepted','production_promotion','new_collection_or_training_allowed'):require(r[key] is False,'Case claims admission')
    counts=r['counts'];require(all(type(v) is int and v>=0 for v in counts.values()),'Invalid operation counters')
    require(counts['static_forwards']<=200 and all(v==0 for k,v in counts.items() if k!='static_forwards'),'Static/forbidden operation budget violated')
    indexed=artifact_check(folder,r,complete);source,grid=inventory_grid(p,index)
    decode=None;decoded=None
    if (folder/'decoded_native_reference.npz').is_file() and (folder/'native_decode_receipt.json').is_file():
        decoded,decode=decoded_readback(folder,source,p)
    if not complete:
        require(r['failure'] is not None or row['status']=='TIME_BUDGET_EXCEEDED','Failed case has no failure/timeout')
        return dict(index=index,status='VERIFIED_HARD_STOP',failure=r['failure'],counts=counts,case_counts=r['case_counts'],
            artifact_provenance=indexed,available_decode_readback=decode,kinematic_gate='NOT_COMPLETED',surface_gate='NOT_COMPLETED',physical_outcome=None)
    require(r['failure'] is None and decode is not None,'Completed case missing decoded evidence')
    require(decode['independent_source_reconstruction_pass'] and decode['independent_saved_parent_arithmetic_pass'],'Completed decoder failed independent numerical gates')
    cc=r['case_counts'];require(cc['parametric_mano_forwards']==2 and cc['full_field_variant_scans']==2,'Two parametric/variant scans contract differs')
    contract=read(source['frame_files']['scene_contract.json']['path']);sr=r['source_receipt']
    close(sr['object_reference_world_position_m'],contract['object_position_m'],1e-12,'Saved object reference position')
    xyzw=contract['object_orientation_xyzw'];contract_R=qmat([xyzw[3],*xyzw[:3]])
    close(sr['object_reference_world_rotation'],contract_R,1e-12,'Saved object reference rotation')
    require(sr['native_sha256']==source['native']['sha256'] and sr['required_relationships']==grid['required_relationships'],'Case native/grid provenance differs')
    m=r['measurement'];require([v['variant'] for v in m['variants']]==['mesh','capsule'],'Both fixed variants/order required')
    poses=[];surfaces=[]
    for v in m['variants']:
        poses.append(variant_readback(folder,v['variant'],decoded,p,source,v));surfaces.append(surface_readback(folder,v['variant'],grid,v))
    pose_status='PASS' if all(v['numerical_pose_pass'] for v in poses) else 'FAIL'
    surface_status='FAIL' if any(v['status']=='FAIL' for v in surfaces) else 'INCOMPLETE'
    require(m['kinematic_pose_transfer_status']==pose_status and m['surface_fidelity_status']==surface_status,'Case aggregate gate interpretation differs')
    require(m['full_orientation_status']=='NOT_RUN','Full orientation unexpectedly measured')
    return dict(index=index,status='VERIFIED_COMPLETED_STATIC_DIAGNOSTIC',result_sha256=row['result_sha256'],counts=counts,case_counts=cc,
        decoded_source=decode,variants=poses,surfaces=surfaces,kinematic_gate=pose_status,surface_gate=surface_status,
        artifact_provenance=indexed,physical_outcome=None,native_fidelity_accepted=False)


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for key in ('root','protocol','run-dir','receipt'):parser.add_argument('--'+key,required=True,type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--freeze-commit',required=True);parser.add_argument('--protocol-sha256',required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--expected-binding-count',required=True,type=int)
    parser.add_argument('--authorized-complete-readback',action='store_true',required=True)
    a=parser.parse_args()
    for key in ('root','protocol','run_dir','receipt'):setattr(a,key,getattr(a,key).resolve())
    require(not a.receipt.exists(),'Append-only native readback receipt already exists')
    require(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',a.freeze_commit) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',a.protocol_sha256),'Literal freeze/protocol required')
    source=Path(__file__).read_bytes();source_sha=hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest();before=False;after=False;errors=[];cases=[];runtime=None;top=None
    try:
        p=freeze_check(a);before=True;runtime=runtime_check(p);started=read(a.run_dir/'started.json');top=read(a.run_dir/'report.json')
        for r in (started,top):require(r['protocol_sha256']==a.protocol_sha256 and r['freeze_commit']==a.freeze_commit,'Actual execution protocol/freeze differs')
        require(started['budgets']==p['budgets'] and [r['index'] for r in top['cases']]==[20,28],'Actual quota/fixed case order differs')
        for row in top['cases']:cases.append(case_readback(a,p,row['index'],row))
        require(top['status']==('COMPLETED_NATIVE_STATIC_PILOT' if all(row['status']=='COMPLETED' for row in top['cases']) else 'HARD_STOP'),'Overall completion status differs')
        for row in top['cases']:
            if row.get('result'):require(sha(row['result'])==row['result_sha256'],'Case result changed during long readback')
    except Exception as error:errors.append(dict(type=type(error).__name__,message=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc()))
    try:
        freeze_check(a);after=True;require(sha(__file__)==source_sha,'Independent verifier source changed');no_models()
        if top is not None:
            for row in top['cases']:
                if row.get('result'):
                    result=read(row['result']);artifact_check(a.run_dir/str(row['index']),result,row['status']=='COMPLETED')
    except Exception as error:errors.append(dict(type=type(error).__name__,message=str(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc()))
    actual=None if top is None else top['status']
    status='READBACK_INTEGRITY_ERROR' if errors else ('VERIFIED_COMPLETED_NATIVE_STATIC_SAVED_ARRAYS' if actual=='COMPLETED_NATIVE_STATIC_PILOT' else 'VERIFIED_NATIVE_STATIC_HARD_STOP')
    inventory={str(path.resolve()):dict(sha256=sha(path),bytes=path.stat().st_size) for path in sorted(a.run_dir.rglob('*')) if path.is_file() and path.resolve()!=a.receipt}
    out=dict(schema_version=SCHEMA,status=status,generated_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),freeze_commit=a.freeze_commit,
        active_protocol_sha256=a.protocol_sha256,expected_bindings=a.expected_binding_count,all_bindings_verified_before=before,
        all_bindings_verified_after=after,runtime_metadata=runtime,actual_execution_status=actual,cases=cases,errors=errors,artifact_inventory=inventory,
        no_model_nativeFK_or_geometry_kernel_execution=True,saved_array_operations='Scalar/NumPy GS, Exp64, parent/quaternion/XML arithmetic and exact cached-field predicates only',
        no_physics_or_new_inference_or_solves_or_training=True,physical_outcome=None,native_fidelity_accepted=False,
        production_promotion=False,new_collection_or_training_allowed=False,
        kinematic_PASS_scope='Numerical rigid bone joint anchors/rotations only; no continuous skin, contact, orientation or physical-fidelity certificate',
        verifier_source_sha256=source_sha,verifier_source_text=source.decode())
    with a.receipt.open('x') as f:json.dump(out,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(status=status,receipt=str(a.receipt),sha256=sha(a.receipt),errors=len(errors),case_statuses=[(c['index'],c['status']) for c in cases])))
    return int(bool(errors))

if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
